caption: The drawing consists of two main groups of human figures, divided roughly in the center. On the left side, there is a depiction of a man with long hair, shown falling to his knees while carrying a large wooden cross; three other men surround him, and one holds a rope tied around the cross. The man with the cross has a crown of thorns on his head and wears a brown robe. The surrounding men are dressed in various colored clothes, primarily in hues of blue, brown, red, and beige, with some wearing helmets or hats. To the upper left, part of a horse’s head, neck, and bridle appear, with a rider holding a staff or spear. Behind the main group is a large blue and white decorative arch with floral motifs. On the right side, there are six figures, four standing behind and two seated or kneeling below. The upper figures wear variously shaded blue and brown hats, one of which is pointed, and a few hold long spears upright. The lower two figures are shown with long brown hair, outlined by blue and yellow arches, and wear red garments. The background of the right side is mostly dark gray or black. The overall composition is framed with a thin, pale tan border along the top and left. The colors throughout are muted and primarily consist of browns, blues, reds, and beiges. There is light pencil handwriting along the top edge that reads, "Jesus Falls The Second Time."
title: Station of the Cross No. 7: "Jesus Falls the Second Time"
